jobs.name: p7u5
jobs.prompt: Underwater at night, looking up from below the surface of a black river: black and deep green-black murky water carved in woodcut gouge lines. High above, the rippling underside of the surface catches a cold pale blue light, carved as broken curved strokes; in the middle of that light, seen through the water, the dark warped silhouette of a small round basket woven of flat black iron straps, like a round wicker basket made of iron bands, seen from directly below through the water: its round woven bottom toward us, the straps crossing in a loose weave, bent and wavering with the ripples, bright cold blue-white fire glowing through the gaps between the straps. No square bars, no box, no cube. Streams of small round bubbles rush up, each bubble a clean simple carved pale ring or dot, many sizes, black water between them. Nothing else. The only color is the cold pale blue light; everything else is black and deep green-black ink.
